message.content: {"caption":"An agent archive tree and iteration-by-iteration SWE-bench progress for DGM without self-improvement.","description":"The left panel is a branching archive-tree diagram: connected circular nodes represent coding agents, with node fill color indicating SWE-bench score and border color indicating evaluation-task count; a star marks the final best agent. The right panel is a line chart of SWE-bench score versus iterations, with series for the archive average, best agent, and lineage to the final best agent. The best-agent score rises from about 0.20 to 0.28 early on and to about 0.39 near iteration 24, then remains level. The archive average stays near 0.21–0.23.
